svg.title: Native Godot scene captures: arrival, refusal, authorized hint, and authored ending
svg.desc: Four complete, unretouched 1280 by 720 engine screenshots, arranged A to D in row order. Labels sit outside the images. Refusal is at the initial state, not an exact replay of the archived fallback event. Authorized hint follows three existing proposal handlers. Ending is a conditional authored end card, not an observed player deduction. Existing lower HUD clipping and curated AI-authored UI art are retained. Illustration only; no efficacy, usability, or frame-performance claim.
